name: kashi
description: کاشی — دیزاین‌سیستم فارسی، RTL-first و چندفریم‌ورکی

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kashi-ui/tokens && npm run build -w @kashi-ui/persian && npm run build -w @kashi-ui/bank-logos && npm run build -w @kashi-ui/icons && npm run build -w @kashi-ui/css && npm run build -w @kashi-ui/react && npm run build -w @kashi-ui/elements && npm run build -w @kashi-ui/tailwind && npm run build -w @kashi-ui/mcp
scripts.test: npm test -w @kashi-ui/tokens && npm test -w @kashi-ui/persian && npm test -w @kashi-ui/icons && npm test -w @kashi-ui/react && npm test -w @kashi-ui/elements && npm test -w @kashi-ui/tailwind && npm test -w @kashi-ui/mcp
scripts.docs:build: npm run build && npm run build -w @kashi-ui/docs
scripts.release: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:consumer && changeset publish

author: Sepanta Pouya (https://sepantapouya.com)
